name: Sedgwick County 4-H
what_you_do: Join a 4-H club that meets monthly. Clubs use hands-on learning to build life skills.
who_can_apply: Sedgwick County residents between ages 7 and 19. You can enroll if you turn 7 before January 1 of the 4-H year. If you turn 19 before January 1, you cannot enroll.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
duration: The 4-H year runs Oct 1 to Sep 30.
deadline_text: Youth can enroll online at any time.
how_to_apply: Call 316-660-0115 to find clubs near you. Then enroll online in Kansas 4-H.
notes: The same page also says 4-H is for ages 5 to 18, and it names a county fair deadline for a different county. To show in the county fair 4-H division, join by May 1. Call the Sedgwick office to confirm.
